json_ld_descriptions: Johnson Law, P.C. is a boutique personal injury law firm based in Hillsboro, Oregon, serving Portland and surrounding areas. We focus on auto accidents, truck accidents, brain injuries, and premises liability cases.

Johnson Law, P.C. is a top-rated Hillsboro personal injury law firm serving Oregon and Southwest Washington with $50M+ recovered, 1,200+ clients helped, a 4.9/5 average rating, award-winning lawyers, and 100% direct attorney access. The firm handles serious accident, injury, wrongful death, and insurance claim cases, fights for maximum compensation, charges no fee unless Johnson Law wins, and uses a Client-First Fee Promise built on simple math: Bills First. Fees Second. Keep More.
